title: decoding nature’s melody: significance and challenges of machine learning in assessing bird diversity via soundscape analysis
core_idea: A focused review of machine learning methods for assessing bird diversity from passive acoustic soundscape data, examining two primary approaches—soundscape component recognition and acoustic indices—by surveying representative recent research, outlining their strengths and limitations, and identifying research gaps and key questions for future studies.
tldr: Survey of ML-based soundscape analysis methods for bird diversity, comparing component recognition and acoustic indices and highlighting gaps to guide future research.
